title: Product Designer
description: Drive end-to-end product experiences from discovery to delivery: user research, journey mapping, wireframing, high-fidelity prototypes, and design systems in Figma.

goal.objective: Solve user problems and deliver high-impact business outcomes through intuitive, delightful, and user-validated end-to-end product design.

learn.summary: Master double-diamond design process, user research methods, information architecture, wireframing, high-fidelity UI design in Figma, usability testing, and handoff.
prerequisites: Visual design sensitivity and typography basics
Empathy for human behavior and user frustration

capstone_projects.title: End-to-End Mobile FinTech Experience Case Study
capstone_projects.description: Conduct user research, design wireframes, build an interactive prototype, and conduct usability tests for a personal wealth management app.

capstone_projects.title: End-to-End Mobile Fintech Design System & Prototype
capstone_projects.description: Conduct user research, synthesize journey maps, design an accessible atomic design token system, and build an interactive micro-animated mobile prototype.

certifications: Nielsen Norman Group UX Master Certified
interview_focus: Articulating the Design Process in Case Study Presentations
Balancing Business Constraints with User Advocacy
Conducting and Synthesizing Usability Testing Feedback
Design System Token Handoff with Frontend Developers

tree.name: Foundational Concepts & Role Definition
tree.description: Establish a strong understanding of product design principles, its history, ethical considerations, and the product designer's role within an organization.

resources.title: The Design of Everyday Things by Don Norman
Product Design Full Course (Google UX Design)

children.name: Product Designer Role & Evolution
children.description: Understand the core responsibilities, historical evolution, and the strategic impact of a Product Designer across different organizational structures and product development stages. Explore the distinctions and overlaps with UX, UI, and Product Management roles.

resources.title: Product Designer vs UX Designer vs UI Designer

children.name: Core Design Principles, Cognitive Psychology & Ethics
children.description: Delve into fundamental design theories, universal principles of good design (e.g., Gestalt, Norman's principles), relevant cognitive psychology concepts (e.g., mental models, Hick's Law), and ethical considerations in design.

resources.title: 100 Things Every Designer Needs to Know About People by Susan Weinschenk

children.name: Product Development Lifecycle & Business Models
children.description: Gain a solid understanding of the end-to-end product development lifecycle, different business models (e.g., SaaS, marketplace), and how product design integrates with business objectives and market forces.

resources.title: The Product Lifecycle: A Complete Guide

children.name: Design Tools & Collaborative Workflow Setup
children.description: Master industry-standard design tools like Figma, focusing on advanced features, plugin integration, team libraries, file organization, and efficient collaborative workflows for a multi-designer environment.

resources.title: Product Design Full Course (Google UX Design)

tree.name: User Research & Strategy
tree.description: Master techniques to understand user needs, behaviors, motivations, and pain points to inform design decisions and product strategy.

resources.title: A Guide to User Research Methods
The Lean UX Book: Applying Lean Principles to Improve User Experience

children.name: Diverse User Research Methods & Planning
children.description: Explore a wide array of qualitative (e.g., in-depth interviews, ethnographic studies, diary studies, contextual inquiry) and quantitative (e.g., surveys, analytics, A/B testing setup) research methods. Learn to plan, scope, and select appropriate methodologies for various project needs.

resources.title: User Research Methods: A Comprehensive Guide

children.name: User Data Synthesis, Insights & Artifacts
children.description: Develop skills in synthesizing raw research data into actionable insights. Create foundational user experience artifacts such as detailed personas, empathy maps, mental models, user journey maps, and service blueprints to communicate findings effectively.

resources.title: How to Create a User Journey Map
Service Blueprints: What They Are & How to Create Them

children.name: Market & Competitive Landscape Analysis
children.description: Conduct thorough market research to understand industry trends, identify emerging opportunities, and perform competitive UX analysis to benchmark against competitors and uncover strategic advantages.

resources.title: Product Design Full Course (Google UX Design)

children.name: Product Vision, Strategy & Problem Framing
children.description: Articulate compelling product visions, define robust product strategies, set clear product goals, and establish success metrics. Master techniques like problem framing, 'jobs-to-be-done,' and hypothesis generation to focus design efforts on the right problems.

resources.title: Jobs To Be Done: A Framework for Product Innovation

children.name: Experiment Design & Research Planning
children.description: Learn to design structured research experiments, formulate clear hypotheses, define success metrics, and manage the logistics of user research studies, ensuring valid and reliable data collection.

resources.title: How to Design a UX Research Study

children.name: User Feedback Tools & Platforms
children.description: Gain practical experience with various tools and platforms for conducting remote user research, usability testing, surveys, and collecting in-app feedback (e.g., UserTesting, Hotjar, Qualtrics, SurveyMonkey).

tree.name: Information Architecture & Interaction Design
tree.description: Structure content effectively and design intuitive user interactions to ensure ease of use and navigation across digital products.

resources.title: Information Architecture Basics for UX Designers
The Elements of User Experience by Jesse James Garrett
Product Design Full Course (Google UX Design)

children.name: Information Architecture & Content Strategy
children.description: Master the principles of organizing, structuring, and labeling content effectively. Develop skills in creating sitemaps, user flows, navigation systems, and conducting card sorting/tree testing. Understand the basics of content strategy in relation to IA.

resources.title: Sitemaps and User Flows in UX Design
Tree Testing: Fast, Iterative Evaluation of IA

children.name: Interaction Design Principles, Heuristics & Patterns
children.description: Apply fundamental interaction design principles (e.g., feedback, consistency, learnability, affordance) and Nielsen's Usability Heuristics. Explore common interaction patterns for various UI elements and user scenarios.

resources.title: Shneiderman's Eight Golden Rules of Interface Design

children.name: Wireframing, Low-Fidelity Prototyping & Ideation
children.description: Develop proficiency in rapid ideation techniques (e.g., sketching, crazy eights). Create basic structural layouts using wireframes and build low-fidelity, clickable prototypes to quickly visualize user flows and test core functionality early in the design process.

children.name: Advanced Interaction Patterns & Complex UI
children.description: Dive into designing complex interaction patterns for data visualization, forms, search, filtering, and dynamic content. Address challenges in designing for enterprise applications, dashboards, and rich internet applications.

resources.title: Product Design Full Course (Google UX Design)

children.name: Accessibility in Interaction Design
children.description: Ensure interactive elements are accessible by designing for keyboard navigation, screen reader compatibility, focus management, and touch targets. Understand ARIA attributes and their role in enhancing interactive accessibility.

tree.name: UI & Visual Design
tree.description: Develop visually appealing and consistent user interfaces that enhance usability, brand identity, and user engagement.

resources.title: Refactoring UI by Adam Wathan & Steve Schoger

children.name: Visual Design Foundations, Branding & Identity
children.description: Master core visual design elements: typography, color theory, layout, grid systems, visual hierarchy, iconography, and imagery. Understand how to apply these principles to establish or reinforce brand identity within a product's interface.

children.name: UI Patterns & Component Design
children.description: Understand common UI patterns (e.g., navigation, forms, data display, alerts) and learn to design reusable, modular UI components. Explore how to leverage and customize existing component libraries (e.g., Material Design, Apple HIG) effectively.

resources.title: Product Design Full Course (Google UX Design)

children.name: Design Systems: Architecture & Governance
children.description: Go beyond the basics to understand the architecture of a design system. Learn to define design tokens, create comprehensive component libraries, document usage guidelines, and establish governance models for maintaining consistency and scalability across products.

children.name: Inclusive Design & Accessibility Standards
children.description: Design products that are usable by the widest possible audience, including people with diverse abilities. Deep dive into WCAG guidelines, ARIA specifications, and inclusive design principles, integrating them throughout the design process.

children.name: Motion & Animation Design for UI
children.description: Learn the principles of effective motion design to enhance user experience, provide feedback, guide attention, and add delight. Explore tools and techniques for creating micro-interactions, transitions, and animations in UI.

resources.title: Designing Interface Animation: Improving Product Experience & Usability

children.name: Responsive & Adaptive Design Principles
children.description: Master designing for multiple screen sizes and devices. Understand the differences between responsive and adaptive design, mobile-first approaches, and techniques for creating flexible layouts and scalable components.

resources.title: Product Design Full Course (Google UX Design)

tree.name: Prototyping, Testing & Iteration
tree.description: Build interactive prototypes, conduct rigorous usability testing, and iterate on designs based on feedback and data to refine user experience.

resources.title: Rocket Surgery Made Easy by Steve Krug

children.name: High-Fidelity Prototyping, Micro-interactions & Advanced Tools
children.description: Create highly realistic and interactive prototypes that simulate the final product experience. Learn to implement intricate micro-interactions, advanced animations, and complex states using tools like Figma, Principle, or ProtoPie.

children.name: Usability Testing: Planning, Moderation & Analysis
children.description: Gain expertise in planning, recruiting for, moderating, and analyzing various usability tests (e.g., moderated, unmoderated, remote, in-person). Learn to identify critical usability issues and translate findings into design recommendations.

children.name: Heuristic Evaluation & Cognitive Walkthrough
children.description: Conduct expert-based evaluations using Nielsen's heuristics and cognitive walkthroughs to identify usability problems early in the design cycle, before involving actual users. Learn to document findings and provide constructive feedback.

resources.title: How to Conduct a Heuristic Evaluation
Product Design Full Course (Google UX Design)

children.name: Experimentation: A/B, Multivariate Testing & Metrics
children.description: Understand the principles of experimental design for product features. Learn to set up, run, and interpret A/B and multivariate tests to quantitatively validate design hypotheses, measure impact on key performance indicators (KPIs), and make data-driven decisions.

resources.title: A/B Testing for UX: A Guide
Multivariate Testing: What Is It and How to Do It

children.name: Design Sprints & Agile Iteration Cycles
children.description: Integrate user feedback, usability test results, and stakeholder input into rapid design iteration cycles. Explore frameworks like Design Sprints for accelerated problem-solving and validation, ensuring continuous improvement.

resources.title: The Design Sprint: A 5-Day Process to Solve Big Problems

tree.name: Cross-functional Collaboration & Handoff
tree.description: Learn to effectively prepare designs for development, collaborate with engineers and product managers, and ensure successful implementation and product launch.

resources.title: Working with Developers: A Guide for Designers

children.name: Design Handoff, Specifications & Developer Collaboration
children.description: Master the art of preparing designs for development. Create comprehensive design specifications, asset libraries, and interactive prototypes for developers. Utilize tools like Figma's Inspect mode, Zeplin, or Storybook for seamless collaboration and efficient implementation.

resources.title: Product Design Full Course (Google UX Design)

children.name: Stakeholder Management & Cross-functional Communication
children.description: Develop strong communication and collaboration strategies to work effectively with product managers, engineers, marketing, and other stakeholders. Learn to manage expectations, negotiate design decisions, and build consensus throughout the product lifecycle.

children.name: Integrating Design in Agile, Scrum & Kanban
children.description: Seamlessly integrate design activities into agile, scrum, and Kanban development methodologies. Learn to participate effectively in sprint planning, stand-ups, reviews, and retrospectives, ensuring design is an integral part of iterative development.

children.name: Design System Maintenance & Contribution
children.description: Actively contribute new components, patterns, and documentation to an existing design system. Understand the processes for proposing changes, maintaining standards, and ensuring the system evolves effectively with product needs and technological advancements.

children.name: Design Operations (DesignOps) Strategy & Scalability
children.description: Understand DesignOps principles to streamline design workflows, optimize toolchains, manage resources, and foster a healthy design culture. Learn how DesignOps enables design teams to scale their impact and efficiency across an organization.

resources.title: Product Design Full Course (Google UX Design)

children.name: Design Presentation & Storytelling
children.description: Develop strong presentation and storytelling skills to effectively communicate design rationale, present solutions to stakeholders, and advocate for user needs. Learn to articulate design decisions based on research and business goals.

tree.name: Portfolio & Career Advancement
tree.description: Prepare for a successful career by building a compelling portfolio, mastering interview skills, and understanding professional development strategies.

resources.title: How to Build a Product Design Portfolio

children.name: Crafting Impactful Design Case Studies
children.description: Master the art of creating compelling case studies that showcase your design process, problem-solving abilities, design decisions, challenges overcome, and the measurable impact of your work, tailored for various audiences.

resources.title: Writing a Great UX Case Study

children.name: Interview Preparation, Whiteboard Challenges & System Design
children.description: Prepare thoroughly for product design interviews, including portfolio reviews, behavioral questions (STAR method), live whiteboard challenges, and product sense/system design questions. Develop strategies for clear communication under pressure.

resources.title: Product Design Full Course (Google UX Design)

children.name: Building a Professional Online Portfolio
children.description: Design and develop a clean, user-friendly online portfolio website that effectively curates and presents your best design projects and case studies, reflecting your personal brand and skills.

children.name: Personal Branding, Networking & Mentorship
children.description: Cultivate a strong personal brand within the design community, engage in professional networking, and seek out mentorship opportunities to foster continuous growth and open doors to new career paths.

resources.title: Building Your Personal Brand as a Designer

children.name: Capstone Project: End-to-End Product Design & Showcase
children.description: Undertake a comprehensive, portfolio-ready product design project from initial research, problem definition, ideation, and design to high-fidelity prototyping, testing, and design specifications, culminating in a polished presentation.

children.name: Continuous Learning & Emerging Design Trends
children.description: Stay abreast of the latest trends, technologies (e.g., AI in design, AR/VR UX), and methodologies in product design. Foster a mindset of continuous learning and adaptation to drive innovation in your career.

resources.title: AI in Design: A Designer's Guide
Product Design Full Course (Google UX Design)
